title: BallBugs and Dinosaurs
description:
This graphics are made to replace Koopas and Galoombas(Goombas) and used in my romhack Power Journey.

If your SMWHack is Vanilla, the original Graphics are in GFX00 and GFX01.

They don't need palette change, so enjoy!

Credits are not needed, but apreciated.
